newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady.
Inquiry good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 11,900 slaughter steers and 12,900 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 84,800 head confirmed including 12,200 head or about 14 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1275 lbs 64.00. Dressed basis - few Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 104.00 hot weights, delivered. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1125 lbs 64.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1090 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.50. Dressed basis - few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 103.50. Confirmed - 24,800
